content.value_statement: Large vector databases can become slow, memory-heavy, and hard to benchmark. This skill provides a structured AgentDB optimization workflow for quantization, HNSW indexing, caching, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides a five-phase workflow for profiling, quantization, indexing, caching, and benchmarking.
Provides TypeScript examples for AgentDB quantization, HNSW index creation, and query caching.
Defines target metrics for memory reduction, p95 latency, throughput, accuracy, and cache hit rate.
Compares product, scalar, and binary quantization options for vector compression.
Supports planning for performance, machine learning, and backend engineering roles.
limitations: Does not install AgentDB packages or run benchmarks automatically.
Performance results depend on data shape, vector dimensions, hardware, and query patterns.
Example code may need adaptation to the active AgentDB API version.
Does not replace production load testing or accuracy evaluation.

use_cases.title: Reduce Memory Footprint
use_cases.description: Tune quantization settings for a large embedding store while preserving search accuracy.

use_cases.title: Improve Search Latency
use_cases.description: Add HNSW indexing and benchmark p95 latency for high-volume vector queries.

use_cases.title: Plan Optimization Work
use_cases.description: Estimate phases, duration, metrics, and validation steps for an AgentDB performance project.

prompt_templates.title: Measure Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me measure baseline AgentDB vector search performance. Include latency, memory, throughput, accuracy, and cache metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner users preparing their first optimization pass.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Quantization
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a quantization strategy for my AgentDB vectors. I need lower memory use while keeping search accuracy above 95 percent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Users deciding between product, scalar, and binary quantization.

prompt_templates.title: Tune HNSW Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an HNSW tuning plan for AgentDB. Include M, efConstruction, efSearch, expected tradeoffs, and benchmark steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate users optimizing latency and recall.

prompt_templates.title: Design Full Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an end-to-end AgentDB optimization plan for millions of vectors. Include baselines, quantization, indexing, caching, batch operations, and acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced users planning a production-scale performance effort.

output_examples.input: A team needs lower memory use for a 1536-dimension embedding index.
output_examples.output: Recommended plan: capture baseline memory, apply product quantization at 4x compression, train codebooks, then compare recall and p95 latency.

output_examples.input: Search latency is too high for frequent nearest-neighbor queries.
output_examples.output: Recommended plan: build an HNSW index, tune construction and search parameters, then benchmark speedup against the original exact search path.

output_examples.input: Repeated queries are creating unnecessary database load.
output_examples.output: Recommended plan: enable an LRU query cache, set a time-based expiration policy, monitor hit rate, and resize the cache from observed traffic.

best_practices: Measure baseline performance before changing quantization, indexing, or caching.
Validate accuracy after every compression or approximate search change.
Benchmark p95 latency and throughput with production-like vector distributions.
anti_patterns: Applying maximum compression before checking recall impact.
Reporting speedup without baseline, dataset size, and hardware context.
Tuning cache size without measuring hit rate and eviction behavior.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps optimize AgentDB vector search for lower memory use, faster search, and measurable performance gains.

faq.question: Does it run the optimization automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, example code, and validation steps for engineers to apply in their environment.

faq.question: Which optimization methods are covered?
faq.answer: It covers quantization, HNSW indexing, query caching, embedding caching, batch operations, and benchmark comparison.

faq.question: Can it help preserve search accuracy?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes accuracy checks after compression and indexing changes.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for machine learning engineers, backend engineers, and technical leads managing vector search performance.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare baseline metrics, representative query sets, dataset size, vector dimensions, and target latency or memory goals.
